subject: Closing sprint — security playbook & retention appendix (QuantaPay)
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@quantapay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@quantapay.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual action plan & security checklist — QuantaPay

Rishi,

Thanks for walking us through the draft MAP last week. Procurement reviewed the materials and we have three outstanding asks before we can sign:

1) SOC 2 scope — can you confirm whether Redwood's SOC 2 report covers the dedicated inference path (the dedicated pool we'll be on) or if that is a subservice description we need to include in the DPA?

2) SIG/CAIQ — we'd like to see the prefilled questionnaire (we started it but want to compare notes).

3) Data retention & deletion — QuantaPay needs explicit windows for (a) user content, (b) embeddings/derived assets, and (c) logs/audit trails. Our legal target is a signed DPA by 2026-12-17 to meet our year-end vendor lock policy. Is that feasible?

Can you send the final MAP PDF + DPA redline + SIG prefill by EOD Thursday (2026-12-03) so our legal and security teams can review?

Appreciate it — small timeline on our side.

— Alex Morgan
Head of Procurement, QuantaPay
Alex.Morgan@quantapay.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-12-03T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security checklist — QuantaPay

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. We'll target the 12/17 DPA signature and I'm attaching the first-pass artifacts for your review. TL;DR: we can meet the timeline with the retention tweak you requested in a follow-up (see final message).

Items attached:
- SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (summary + scope page) — confirms SOC 2 Type II for our hosted API and the dedicated-capacity control overlay; dedicated pools are included as a scoped service with a subservice description.
- SIG-CAIQ-prefill.xlsx — our team's answers are prefilled where allowed.
- DPA-redline-v1.pdf — standard Redwood DPA with a comment track on retention and data residency.

Quick answers here:
- SOC 2 scope: dedicated pool is in-scope via subservice description; we'll include the same controls mapping in the DPA exhibit for your security team to cross-check.
- SIG/CAIQ: we've provided rationales in the prefills; anything marked "TBD" is an architectural nuance and we've flagged a contact for follow-up (Laura).
- Retention defaults we propose:
  * Customer content (raw requests/responses): retained until explicit deletion request; default auto-delete after 365 days if not configured.
  * Embeddings/derived artifacts: default 90 days; customers can opt-in to longer retention via contract.
  * Logs & audit trails: 180 days (can be shortened to 90 with an SLA impact note).

Next steps: please loop in your security contact for a short sync if they want to walk the SIG answers line-by-line. If those retention defaults are acceptable, we'll incorporate the 12/17 signature milestone into the MAP and send a DocuSign link.

Attachments in this message: SIG-CAIQ-prefill.xlsx (stub), DPA-redline-v1.pdf (stub), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (stub).

Thanks — Rishi
Director, GTM Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@quantapay.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security checklist — QuantaPay

On Thu, Dec 3, 2026 at 10:04 AM Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Quick answers here:

Alex / team — adding a few technical clarifications from engineering and a data-retention matrix attached. Highlights: 

- Encryption & KMS: All customer data at rest is encrypted with customer-specific envelope keys; we integrate with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / Google Cloud KMS) for Private deployments and with Redwood-managed KMS for Hosted customers when requested.

- Data residency: For EU-held data, we support region pinning in the Dedicated pool; the DPA redline includes a clause to pin storage and inference hosts to eu-west-1 where requested.

- Retention breakdown (see data-retention-matrix.csv):
  * Raw requests/responses: retained as Rishi noted — default 365 days unless an account-level retention policy is set to shorter.
  * Embeddings / derivative vectors: stored in isolated vector stores with lifecycle rules; default 90 days for Hosted accounts, 180 days available for Dedicated or by contract.
  * Logs / audit trails: 180 days by default (search/forensics), then archived for 2 years in a compressed, access-controlled bucket (archives are retained per customer agreement).

- Deletion process: Once a deletion request is received we execute a multi-stage purge: (1) remove from active stores, (2) invalidate & rotate KV caches, (3) schedule object lifecycle purge (S3 lifecycle expedited for contractual deletions), (4) note in audit log. We provide a deletion confirmation report as an attachment when the process completes.

- SOC 2 evidence: A redacted SOC 2 report is attached (SOC2-summary-2026.pdf). If QuantaPay needs direct access to our auditor, we can facilitate a bridge call under NDA.

Attachments in this message: data-retention-matrix.csv (stub).

Happy to join a 30-minute call with your security team to walk the SIG answers and the retention matrix — propose 2026-12-07 or 12-08.

— Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference

Rishi / Laura — short note to confirm:

1) Procurement and Legal have reviewed the artifacts. The SOC 2 summary and SIG prefill address our top risks.
2) We will accept the DPA redline with one retention change: logs/audit trails retained for 180 days (Redwood's default), and archived compressed copies retained for up to 2 years as described.
3) Embeddings retention: we'll accept 90 days for Hosted during evaluation, then revisit for production.

We're ready to sign the MAP and DPA. I've completed the HubSpot record and uploaded the Exec approval. Attaching the signed MAP as confirmation. Please send the DocuSign DPA link and we'll run final signature by EOD 2026-12-17.
